name: count span is a plain inline box again
why: Without the inline grid the ::after sizer is just trailing invisible text that ADDS width instead of setting a minimum, so the span still grows with its text and the controls after it shift.

edits.find: .mb-row-count-stat { font-weight: bold; margin-left: 8px; display: inline-grid; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
edits.replace: .mb-row-count-stat { font-weight: bold; margin-left: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

name: the helper never writes the sizer
why: attr() of a missing attribute is the empty string, so the slot collapses to the visible text: today's shifting behaviour, with the CSS still in place.

name: the multi-table h2 reserves only the 2-tier slot
why: The h2 of a multi-table page shows (F of T)/A under a global filter. A (8 of 8) sizer is wide enough for every h3 and for a single-table h2, so only the multi-table h2 notices; the /A tail pushes the master toggle right.
